record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare ROCK_SLIDE in this production reference (all with passive NONE in the catalog, range 1; maxPP 100 except Aerodactyl 80). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: Single-target special damage (30/60/120/240 raw by the caster's stars), doubled before the damage call when the target has the FLYING synergy type. No status, heal or buff.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the attacking-state gate.

conditional.condition: target has Synergy.FLYING in its entity types
conditional.note: the doubling is applied to the raw value before handleSpecialDamage, so it stacks multiplicatively with the AP factor; the target's types are the base Pokemon's types copied at construction plus any type added by a held synergy stone

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); crit multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit, which requires EffectEnum.ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw [x2 if FLYING] x AP factor [x crit]; the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) gives the applied amount in handleDamage; takenDamage (not used by this strategy) would count HP removed plus shield damage; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0)

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (240, also the fallback) is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). Aerodactyl has maxPP 80, the others 100.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must have a target at range to reach the cast gate).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the damage; the FLYING check is made at every cast against the target's current types.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30/60/120 (1/2/3 stars), doubled against FLYING targets (60/120/240). Requested damage = raw [x2] x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]; applied damage after the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced later modifiers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after the later handleDamage modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, the minimum of 1 and the takenDamage accounting were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution beyond the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier
unresolved: Whether other code adds or removes entity types during a fight (only construction and addItem were read), which would change the FLYING check
Whether any item or synergy effect changes ROCK_SLIDE beyond what is listed
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
